The dataset, time window, and description of the issue. The /community/data-library/issues/create API accepts requests in the following format:

CreateDataIssueRequest Model - Request body to report a data issue.
ticker string
required
example: SPY
Ticker of the security with the issue.
security string Enum
required
Asset class of the dataset. Options : ['Equity', 'Equity Option', 'Index', 'Index Option', 'Future', 'Future Option', 'Forex', 'CFD', 'Crypto', 'Crypto Future']
market string
required
example: USA
Market of the dataset. The valid markets depend on the asset class, as shown in the market dropdown on the Data Issues page.
resolution string Enum
required
Resolution of the dataset. The valid resolutions depend on the asset class and market. Options : ['Tick', 'Second', 'Minute', 'Hour', 'Daily', 'Coarse Fundamental', 'Fine Fundamental', 'Margin']
from-date string
required
example: 2024-08-01
First date of the issue, in YYYY-MM-DD format.
to-date string
required
example: 2024-08-02
Last date of the issue, in YYYY-MM-DD format. The end of the time window must be after the start.
from-time string
example: 09:30
Time of day the issue starts, in HH:MM format. Required for Second and Minute resolution when the time window is shorter than 7 days.
to-time string
example: 16:00
Time of day the issue ends, in HH:MM format. Required for Second and Minute resolution when the time window is shorter than 7 days.
corrupted-files string Enum
Include to report files that can't be read. Include at least one issue type. Options : ['Corrupted Files']
missing-points string Enum
Include to report missing data points. Options : ['Missing Points']
missing-files string Enum
Include to report missing files. Options : ['Missing Files']
wrong-values string Enum
Include to report wrong values. Options : ['Wrong Values']
listing-error string Enum
Include to report a listing error. Options : ['Listing Error']
split-error string Enum
Include to report a split error. Options : ['Split Error']
dividend-error string Enum
Include to report a dividend error. Options : ['Dividend Error']
name-mapping-error string Enum
Include to report a ticker mapping error. Options : ['Name Mapping Error']
content string
required
example: SPY data is missing on 2024-08-01.
HTML description of the issue.
select-project integer
Id of one of your projects to attach to the issue, so the Data team can see the code that shows the issue. To get your project Ids, use the /projects/read endpoint.
select-backtest string
Id of a backtest of the attached project to attach to the issue. Requires select-project. To get the backtest Ids of a project, use the /backtests/list endpoint.
Example 
{
  "ticker": "SPY",
  "security": "Equity",
  "market": "USA",
  "resolution": "Tick",
  "from-date": "2024-08-01",
  "to-date": "2024-08-02",
  "from-time": "09:30",
  "to-time": "16:00",
  "corrupted-files": "Corrupted Files",
  "missing-points": "Missing Points",
  "missing-files": "Missing Files",
  "wrong-values": "Wrong Values",
  "listing-error": "Listing Error",
  "split-error": "Split Error",
  "dividend-error": "Dividend Error",
  "name-mapping-error": "Name Mapping Error",
  "content": "SPY data is missing on 2024-08-01.",
  "select-project": 0,
  "select-backtest": "string"
}
